name: Suq al Shyukh

queries.query: Suq al Shuyukh Iraq cadastral parcel map official land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Iraq Ministry of Justice Real Estate Registration Directorate contact page, which lists a dedicated Suq al Shuyukh directorate, and the official Ur Portal deed/property-map service. No public parcel API or downloadable geometry endpoint was identified.

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry of Justice contact directory lists the dedicated Suq al Shuyukh Real Estate Registration Directorate and mailbox souqal_shouekh_iqari@moj.gov.iq.
Official Ur Portal describes the deed and property-map request service, requiring owner or authorized representative documents and stating electronic availability at that time only in Baghdad.
Official service application route loads a citizen JavaScript application and requires Ur Portal login; no public parcel response was exposed.
Official Ministry of Justice announcement describes electronic property deed/map and related real-estate services being rolled out incrementally through Ur Portal.
